title: implement AveragePool

atoms.evidence: class AveragePool(nn.Module): with only forward (no __init__/Parameter — pure reduction)
solution: return t.mean(x, dim=(2, 3)) — global average pool over spatial H,W dims, collapsing (B,C,H,W) -> (B,C)

atoms_in_seed_but_not_actually_present.reason: seed predicted broadcasting for exercise 6 but global avg pool is a pure reduction over named dims, no broadcasting involved

notes: Trivial 2-atom Module — same shape as ReLU (no params, no extra_repr). Confirms avgpool-reduce as load-bearing and confirms it really is the *global* avg pool variant (collapses spatial dims entirely to feed into the final Linear of a ResNet), not a sliding-window avgpool.
